scope: Owner-authorized immediate same-page section navigation with a subtle destination fade; no page/header geometry or content change.
mechanism: Shared root CSS uses auto so native jumps and Back/Forward restoration avoid smooth travel. Window bubble listener follows target/document controllers and preserves native history/default navigation. Only clicks farther than max(320px, half viewport) receive a visible destination-section fade from .72 to1 over200ms. No temporary styles or global method interception.
accessibility: Reduced motion retains instant jump with no animation. No focus reassignment or invented history entries.
